title: THE HISTORY — the aggregate overlap history of humanity worldwide
note: The overlap view: every civilization, empire, religion, and age laid on one timeline. Dates are approximate consensus ranges (BCE/CE). The overlap is the point: while one world rose, another fell, and another had not yet begun.

events.what: Bronze Age collapse — the Sea Peoples
Confucius born (551 BCE); the Buddha's lifetime (c. 563–483 BCE) overlaps
Battle of Marathon — Greece repels Persia
Qin unifies China; Great Wall begun
Great Schism — East and West churches split
Columbus reaches the Americas; Granada falls
Galileo — telescope turns to the sky
Apollo 11 — humans walk on the Moon
Cold War ends; the web goes public
Battle of Talas — Abbasids defeat Tang; papermaking spreads west
Battle of Yarmouk — Rashidun defeat Byzantines; Syria lost to Rome
Sasanian Empire falls — Yazdegerd III killed at Merv
Battle of Tondibi — Songhai falls to Morocco
British punitive expedition — Benin sacked, bronzes taken
Caral-Supe founded — the first city in the Americas
Modu Chanyu founds the Xiongnu Empire
Lindisfarne raid — the Viking Age begins
Oleg the Wise makes Kiev the Rus capital
Silla surrenders to Goryeo — Korea unified
Rapa Nui colonized; moai era begins
Mongols sack Kiev — Kievan Rus ends
Dutch reach Easter Island — Rapa Nui's isolation ends
Sargon of Akkad — the first territorial empire
Teotihuacan founded — the Americas' greatest city rises
Chenla conquers Funan — Southeast Asia's first state absorbed
Khazar Khaganate forms — the steppe's Jewish kingdom
Kievan Rus destroys the Khazar Khaganate
Battle of Hastings — the Viking Age ends
Ayutthaya falls to Burma — Siam's capital destroyed
Monte Alban founded — Zapotec civilization rises
Baekje founded — one of Korea's Three Kingdoms
Silla + Tang destroy Goguryeo — Korea's Three Kingdoms era ends
Sundiata takes Ghana's capital — Mali Empire rises
Inca conquer Chimu — Chan Chan falls
Ivan III annexes Novgorod — Moscow unifies Russia
